defect: Escape dismissed an open interaction without sending its cancel response
scenario: A provider interaction is focused and the user presses Escape; the overlay closes while the provider remains blocked on the unanswered interaction
evidence: Applied forwarding at src/views/tui/terminal-app.ts:355; node scripts/run-suite.mjs all -> 9 of 9 pass; InteractionShell cancel path covered in test/w6-ui.test.ts
fix: Let the focused interaction receive Escape and keep global shortcuts out of the interaction modal
verification: node scripts/test-pty.mjs -> 4 of 4 sizes pass; node scripts/run-suite.mjs all -> 9 of 9 pass
costIfShipped: 1 blocked interaction per affected Escape action
savedIfFixed: 1 blocked interaction per affected Escape action

defect: A delayed dispatch callback could update a stopped terminal
scenario: A send or unavailable response resolves after Ctrl+D or SIGINT; the callback opens a modal or requests a render against a closed TUI
evidence: Stopped guard at src/views/tui/terminal-app.ts:340; node scripts/run-suite.mjs all -> 9 of 9 pass
fix: Return from the completion callback once the terminal has stopped
verification: node scripts/test-pty.mjs -> 4 of 4 sizes pass with clean exit; node scripts/run-suite.mjs all -> 9 of 9 pass
costIfShipped: 1 stale callback per late response, with terminal-state corruption risk

defect: Readonly view types were only shallowly frozen
scenario: A component mutates an activity item, capability entry, or headless message array received from the controller; later renders observe changed shared state
evidence: Deep freeze implementation at src/views/shared/models.ts:346; immutable snapshot assertions in test/w6-contract.test.ts; 9 of 9 test files pass
fix: Recursively freeze view and headless data with cycle protection
costIfShipped: 1 shared view mutation per violating component
savedIfFixed: 1 shared view mutation per violating component

defect: Generic command parameters accepted wrong JSON types before dispatch
scenario: A client sends a numeric projection, malformed profile record, or non-string worker identifier; the protocol accepts the request and reports an unrelated capability result
evidence: Parameter type and required-field checks at src/views/headless/rpc.ts:120-207 and :285; malformed parameter regression in test/w6-contract.test.ts
fix: Validate every declared parameter type and required field before command execution
verification: node scripts/run-suite.mjs all -> 9 of 9 pass; node scripts/test-rpc-packed.mjs -> 16 JSONL responses pass
costIfShipped: 1 malformed request per client call reaching execution

defect: UTF-16 slicing could split a surrogate pair at title or notification bounds
scenario: An untrusted string ends with a supplementary Unicode character at the 120- or 512-unit boundary; the rendered value contains a lone surrogate
evidence: Code-point truncation at src/views/shared/sanitize.ts:100-101; surrogate-boundary regression in test/sanitize.test.ts
fix: Bound sanitized strings by code points instead of UTF-16 code units
costIfShipped: 1 malformed displayed character per boundary hit
savedIfFixed: 1 malformed displayed character per boundary hit
